name: Extract three details from a page
short_description: Read an ordinary page and accurately extract three explicitly stated details.
self_assessment: I can extract three stated details from one page without help.
description: Read an ordinary page and accurately extract three explicitly stated details. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
